name: White Rebellion — Unisex White Floral
claim: A literature-bounded, exact product-mass design and conditional stock realization; no sensory, clone, liking, safety or release superiority.

locked_brief.text: Approachable gender-open white floral in the Good girl gone Bad territory: tuberose, orange blossom and apricot-osmanthus remain the heart. Bitter-green citrus, mineral/skin musk and pale woods frame the flowers without making a dry masculine amberwood scent.
locked_brief.temporal_goal: Opening identity -> coherent heart -> subordinate supportive drydown; not a measured trajectory

chassis.mobile_sockets: Trace modifiers, texture support and competing musk/amber alternatives only within this brief
chassis.omission_plan: Compare LEAD with AIRY_CONSERVATIVE for density/oiliness. For musk nonredundancy, compare separate carrier-matched no-Habanolide and no-Ambrettolide controls; only then test the Romandolide replacement if metallicness is objectionable. Reject woody-men's-fragrance, grape-candy, sunscreen or leather-first drift.

decision_changes: Put the tuberose-orange-osmanthus axis ahead of the dry framework; this is an intentional new mass target, not a volume-equivalent conversion.
Keep Tuberlia's reproducible commercial body and natural tuberose's texture separate. The base remains opaque; it is not a molecule or an analytical tuberose surrogate.
Use only Habanolide (mineral-air hypothesis) and Ambrettolide (fruit-skin hypothesis). Romandolide is a substitute test, not a third default musk.
Remove Cedramber and extra Haiti vetiver from the lead. Keep polished Vetiveryl Acetate, small cedar/Clearwood and only 2% crystal Ambrox.
Use the user's newer neat Ambrettolide statement explicitly, while leaving the stale 10% inventory entry untouched. Aurantiol's uncertain strength remains an explicit branch.

candidates.hypothesis: Restored floral axis with restrained dry contrast.
Less creamy/oily weight while preserving the core flowers.
Replace rather than stack the mineral musk.
More apricot/tea/leather; reject if tuberose-orange identity disappears.
Compressed independent chassis testing whether micro-facets add richness.
No authenticated quantitative reference, original prompt recovery or sensory calibration is available; official notes cannot supply a literal formula.

pareto.selection_reason: Qualitative design coverage and practical stock accounting, not demonstrated sensory superiority

accounting.concentration_definition: 20% by undiluted perfumery-product-equivalent mass, not 20% identified odorant or stock volume

finished_options.ethanol: q.s. measured final 30.00 mL after dissolution and equilibration

accounting.ethanol_96_percent_as_supplied: Count as solvent product mass; strength basis not silently converted to absolute-ethanol mass

small_sample.extra_alcohol_rule: If a grams of dissolution ethanol enters the master, aliquot (stock_total+a)/6 and add 5-(stock_total+a)/6 grams ethanol; never count a twice.

stock_notes: Tuberose and osmanthus bottles are listed as 10% DPG but their basis is unstated. The exact recipe requires 10% w/w. Verify that Jasmine Sambac is the intended absolute/product, not dried blossoms or an unrelated base. Apritone's old 10% w/v is not a 1% w/w stock. Indole's parent stock basis must be known before serial dilution. No photos or purchase receipts are required for this personal design.
stock_preparations: Aurantiol: use a confirmed 10% w/w DPG stock; or for this batch use exactly 0.090 g neat Aurantiol + 0.810 g DPG instead of 0.900 g stock. Choose one branch only. A bottle marked merely 10% of unknown basis cannot use this equivalence.

Ambrettolide: default is 0.120 g neat, following the user. If the actual bottle is the older 10% w/w DPG stock, use 1.200 g of it instead, adding 1.080 g carrier; the alternative total stock charge is 10.6224 g and alcohol to 30 g is 19.3776 g. Do not add both branches.
Apritone 1% w/w ethanol: 0.10 g neat PW 3FD06779 + 9.90 g ethanol. Cardamom 10% w/w ethanol: 0.10 g neat + 0.90 g ethanol.
Indole 1% w/w DPG: 1.00 g confirmed 10% w/w stock + 9.00 g DPG. Reuse correctly identified homogeneous natural stocks if their w/w basis is known; otherwise obtain/prepare the required stock.
mixing_order: Dissolve 120 mg crystal Ambrox using a portion of the final alcohol allowance; count that alcohol in the ledger.
Weigh pale woods, the two selected musks and salicylates; add Hedione and Hedione HC.
Add Tuberlia, the correctly identified natural floral stocks and exactly one Aurantiol branch; follow with floral-body esters/ketones.
Add Indole and Apritone working stocks, then neroli, petitgrain, citrus and spices last. Close, mix and inspect after equilibration.
